entries.note_hr: Put Malog Princa u NP Paklenica zatvoren je do daljnjeg zbog dotrajalih elemenata osiguranja i pomagala u prolasku zahtjevnoga planinarskog puta.
entries.note_en: Put Malog Princa in NP Paklenica is closed until further notice due to worn safety elements and aids on this demanding trail.

entries.note_hr: U NP Risnjak od 26. lipnja 2026. zatvara se planinarski ulaz Vilje te planinarska staza Vilje - Risnjak (dio staze 108).
entries.note_en: In NP Risnjak, the Vilje mountain entrance and the Vilje - Risnjak trail (part of trail 108) are closed from 26 June 2026.

entries.note_hr: Većina planinarskih staza na Medvednici pretrpjela je značajna oštećenja uslijed nedavnog nevremena te se stanje staza još uvijek sanira.
entries.note_en: Most hiking trails on Medvednica suffered significant damage due to a recent storm; restoration work is still ongoing.

entries.note_hr: Toplinski val u Gospićkoj regiji (Lika / Velebit). Maksimalna temperatura > 34 °C. Stupanj pripravnosti: Narančasto. Povećan zdravstveni rizik za osjetljive skupine.
entries.note_en: Heat wave in the Gospić region (Lika / Velebit). Maximum temperature > 34 °C. Alert level: Orange. Increased health risk for vulnerable populations.
entries.gear: High-factor sun protection, minimum 3 L water, electrolytes; avoid exposed ridgeline hiking during peak afternoon heat

entries.note_hr: Toplinski val u Riječkoj regiji (Kvarner / Gorski kotar / Risnjak / Učka). Maksimalna temperatura > 36 °C; minimalna temperatura > 25 °C. Stupanj pripravnosti: Crveno. Mogući kvarovi infrastrukture.
entries.note_en: Heat wave in the Rijeka region (Kvarner / Gorski kotar / Risnjak / Učka). Maximum temperature > 36 °C; minimum temperature > 25 °C. Alert level: Red. Infrastructure failures possible.
entries.gear: High-factor sun protection, minimum 3 L water, electrolytes; avoid prolonged exertion; consider postponing high-altitude sections
